description: Story Phase 5 (What Does the Grand Stenchmaster Actually Do?) has begun: the morning after the 700% forecast.
Rounds: Pete at the port rail (patch 'Gerald'). One bell, and he was gone.
Rounds: Gristle's stock count, abandoned when the Center came out of the treasure-room door.
Rounds: the Center came down the galley stovepipe AGAIN. Jim screamed at Garrick up the ladder.
Rounds: Bob asleep sitting up; three bells; Dunstan out of the washroom in a towel; Bob saved his pillow.
Three bells at the mainmast, with Squawks's basket in the way.
The captain has Squawks under his coat (the close call).
Squawks got clear, aft. The last three wisps of down blew away.
Squawks is fully bald: no feather, tuft or wisp. Alive, wrapped up, furious. (Phase 5 canon.)
The crew gathered round Squawks's basket by the cabin door.
The Squawks check-in: 'Bald.' 'Everything feels drafty.' 'Want new crew.' 'Unfortunately.'
Chapter 21: What Do You Actually Do? (CRUNCH, Shark Duty, the confrontation).
The first watch is over and every head on deck has turned to the chair.
The crew confronted the Grand Stenchmaster at his chair.
Duties one to five: seat readiness, Frog Grog QA, strategic releases, executive readiness, and the S.E.S.
The Stenchmaster Entertainment System exists: an impossible CRT made of ship junk, at the Grand Stenchmaster's station. (Permanent.)
The captain has looked at the S.E.S. close up.
The captain has looked at the S.E.S. wiring. ('I recognise none of this.')
The captain has looked at the S.E.S. power source. ('And yet.')
The S.E.S. has been slapped back into working order at least once.
The crew have confronted Garrick about his duties. 'Ye have invented a royal office for being lazy.'
'Back to work.' 'THAT IS NOT WORK.' 'Contractual disagreement.'
Chapter 22: The Grand Stenchmaster's Office.
The Grand Stenchmaster's station midships is permanent: S.E.S., chair, grog table, Stench Log, crayons, Forecast Board.
The office shift is over (Garrick heckled throughout; 'WE KNOW!').
The rudder: a shark Nell calls Admiral. The captain directed the crew.
The Stench Log page: MONITORED READINESS, and administrative moisture.
Garrick has gone to the galley for noon Frog Grog 'quality assurance'.
'Warm.' 'I hate that he was telling the truth.'
The captain sat in the Grand Stenchmaster's chair. It was very comfortable. Everyone saw.
The Center sat on Jim's first proper bread in a week. He'd named the dough.
Brask opened the washroom door, saw the Center, and closed it again. 'I'll wait.'
Pete at the mainmast rigging: 'Not again.'
Three bells: the Center rolled onto the Grand Stenchmaster's station.
The Center went over the washing line. Every shirt aboard is custard-coloured now.
The crew got clear of the station; Ned took the long way round.
Garrick walked back through the Center and sat down. 'Pre-warmed.'
Chapter 23: Dressed for Disaster (the starboard rail goes, Garrick vanishes).
Garrick found behind the crates in the hold, sewing. 'Assemble the crew.'
The crew assembled round the main hatch for whatever this is.
THE GRAND STENCHMASTER SUIT exists, with the sash sewn into it. Garrick wears it. (Permanent.)
The suit came up the ladder with a fanfare nobody can explain.
Garrick explained his medal: Survived First Release.
Garrick explained his medal: Founded Frog Grog.
Garrick explained his medal: First Shark Diversion.
Garrick explained his medal: Founded Stench Forecasts.
Garrick explained his medal: A Very Difficult Nap (the bottle cap).
The captain heard about all five medals (one is a bottle cap).
The suit tour: sash, epaulettes, medals, odour-retentive coat, brass-glued boots.
'Every Grand Stenchmaster.' 'There has NEVER BEEN ANOTHER.' 'Somebody has to establish the standards.'
Ordered to help, Garrick refused: the suit is formalwear. 'Morale.' 'IT IS NOT HELPING.'
Starboard bite patched.
Starboard stanchion braced.
Starboard gap boarded up.
The starboard rail is whole again. Morale, according to Garrick, has never been higher.
Chapter 24: One Useful Thing (everything at once).
The captain got Squawks off the quarterdeck. 'Nothing left to take.'
The rails held through the combined emergency.
The crew unloaded on the Grand Stenchmaster. 'The parrot has NO FEATHERS!' 'Confirmed.'
The labour rule, nailed to the mainmast: in a genuine emergency the Grand Stenchmaster does at least ONE useful thing. 'Leadership' does not count. (Permanent.)
Garrick booted a shark on the nose with a brass boot. 'That's my one.'
Night after the longest day.
'Still bald.' 'Still here.' '...Both.'
The S.E.S. at night: something almost appeared. 'Programming.' 'Executive readiness.'
Story Phase 5 (What Does the Grand Stenchmaster Actually Do?) is complete.
